summary: A focus timer that runs 25-minute sessions with start, pause, and reset controls, shows the minutes and seconds remaining, notifies the user when a session ends, and keeps a count of sessions completed today that survives restarts.
targetUsers: People who want to work in timed focus intervals
Students and knowledge workers tracking daily focus sessions
goals: Run a 25-minute focus session with start, pause, and reset controls
Show the remaining minutes and seconds of the current session
Notify the user when a focus session ends
Show how many sessions were completed today
Persist completed sessions on the device and restore them after restart

features.name: Focus session timer
features.userOutcome: The user runs a 25-minute focus session and can start, pause, and reset it while seeing the minutes and seconds left.
features.trigger: The user presses Start, Pause, or Reset on the timer.
features.behavior: The timer begins at 25:00. Start begins counting down one second at a time; Pause stops the countdown and keeps the remaining time; Reset returns the timer to 25:00 and stops it. The remaining time is displayed as minutes and seconds (MM:SS) and updates every second while running. When the countdown reaches 00:00 the session is complete: the timer stops at 00:00, a desktop notification titled 'Focus session complete' with body 'Your 25-minute focus session has ended.' is requested, and a completed session record is created with the completion moment stamped by the app.
features.failureOutcome: If the notification request is denied or unavailable, the session still completes and the completed session is still recorded.
acceptanceSignals: After pressing Start, the displayed remaining time decreases by one second per second from 25:00.
After pressing Pause, the displayed remaining time stays unchanged across at least two seconds.
After pressing Reset, the displayed remaining time is 25:00 and the timer is not running.
When the countdown reaches 00:00, a notification request with title 'Focus session complete' and body 'Your 25-minute focus session has ended.' is made and a completed session record is created.

features.name: Today's completed session count
features.userOutcome: The user sees how many focus sessions were completed today, including sessions completed before a restart.
features.trigger: The app is open and a session completes.
features.behavior: The app counts stored completed session records whose completion date is the current calendar day and displays that count as a number. The count is recomputed when a session completes and when the app starts, so sessions completed earlier today are included after a restart. When no sessions have been completed today the count displays 0.
features.failureOutcome: If stored sessions cannot be read, the count displays 0 and the app continues running.
acceptanceSignals: With two stored completed sessions dated today and one dated yesterday, the displayed count is 2.
With no stored completed sessions dated today, the displayed count is 0.
After a session completes, the displayed count increases by one without restarting the app.

dataObjects.name: Completed sessions
dataObjects.purpose: Records each focus session that ran to completion so today's count can be shown and restored after restart.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept on the device so completed sessions survive restarts and can be counted by day.

qualityRequirements: The remaining time display updates once per second while the timer is running.
The completed session count reflects stored records immediately after a session completes and after app restart.
productConstraints: A focus session is fixed at 25 minutes.
Completed sessions are stored only on the device.
